instruction.text:
Mrs Downing would like to get some new books and a new whiteboard for her class. The books cost £364 and the whiteboard costs £147.

In steps, calculate how much the new things will cost.

Sum:
instruction.sound: Mrs Downing would like to get some new books and a new whiteboard for her class. The books cost £364 and the whiteboard costs £147. In steps, calculate how much the new things will cost.

trainers.hint: Add the hundreds first, then the tens and then the units.

atoms.sound: The new things will cost 511 pounds.

instruction.text:
Class 5B are going on a school trip. They have to travel 484 km by bus and then another 219 km by ferry.

In steps, calculate the total distance they are covering.

Sum:
instruction.sound: Class 5B are going on a school trip. They have to travel 484 km by bus and then another 219 km by ferry. In steps, calculate the total distance they will cover.

trainers.hint: Add the hundreds first, then the tens and then the units.

atoms.b:
Answer:
They will cover a total of 703`km`.
atoms.sound: They will cover a total of 703 km.

instruction.text:
Kai is reading a book that has 864 pages. He has already read 592 pages.

In steps, calculate how many pages Kai still has to read.

Sum:
instruction.sound: Kai is reading a book that has 864 pages. He has already read 592 pages. In steps, calculate how many pages Kai still has to read.

trainers.hint: First subtract the hundreds, then the tens and then the units.

atoms.b:
Answer:
Kai still has 272 pages to read.
atoms.sound: Kai still has 272 pages to read.

instruction.text:
Alicia is really looking forward to her next birthday. Her last birthday was 279 days ago. There are 365 days in a year.

In steps, calculate how many more days Alicia needs to wait.


Sum:
instruction.sound: Alicia is really looking forward to her next birthday. Her last birthday was 279 days ago. There are 365 days in a year. In steps, calculate how many more days Alicia needs to wait.

atoms.b:
Answer:
Alicia still has to wait 86 days.
atoms.sound: Alicia still has to wait 86 days.
